prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is visible and within reach, grasp it, process it, and release it. Otherwise, scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GraspObject    /> <Action ID = ReleaseObject    /> <Action ID = ProcessObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectWithinReach    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <BehaviorTree ID = FindAndProcessObject>     <Fallback>         <Sequence>             <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />             <Action ID = ApproachObject    />             <Condition ID = IsObjectWithinReach    />             <Action ID = GraspObject    />             <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />             <Action ID = ReleaseObject    />         </Sequence>         <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />     </Fallback> </BehaviorTree>"
code:
SELECTOR
		SEQUENCE
				IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
				DO ApproachObject
		ELSE
				IF IsObjectWithinReach? THEN
				DO GraspObject
		ELSE
			DO ProcessObject
			DO ReleaseObject
		END
		DO ScanAreaForObject
	END
